authority: Jordan approved optional Pij-ID implementation; PM narrow follow-on
goal: One optional shared --pij ID query selector; defer lookup to app without changing frozen core query ports

interface.command: pub struct PijQueryCommand { pub id:String, pub query:QueryCommand, pub target:PijTarget }; pub enum PijTarget { Query, SessionShow, SourceCheck }
interface.resolution: --pij is an alternative scope. Validated pending request is not executable until app replaces scope/session and applies PijTarget. SessionShow and SourceCheck temporarily carry List explicitly as unresolved frontend state; final SDK operation is Show or Check with real native-derived IDs.
interface.failure: pub fn emit_pij_failure(code:&str,message:&str,next_action:&str,mode:OutputMode,stderr:&mut dyn Write)->u8; emits safe app-supplied static strings, stable JSON error envelope/next_action or human error, exit1 unless writing fails (also1). No stdout parameter.
interface.provenance: pub fn emit_pij_resolution(pij_id:&str,harness:&str,session_id:EntityId,source_id:SourceId,mode:OutputMode,stderr:&mut dyn Write)->std::io::Result<()>; one JSON diagnostic record or human summary. Do not emit raw native session ID, machine, cwd or source path. IDs passed by PM are explicit seat or validated hashes.

rules: Shared --pij on Sources/Sessions/Turns/Messages/Tools/Events query leaves; no native export/root/native Git Notes changes. Sources may resolve source scope; session restriction for row queries is PM responsibility.

Exactly one source scope: --pij conflicts with --repo,--source,--input and non-default --repo-scope; reject --session,--native-id,--harness,--source-adapter and corresponding excluded harness/adapter selectors when --pij used to avoid contradictory native identities. Reject invalid/empty/leading-option/control IDs safely. Do not echo rejected text.

For sessions show permit missing positional entity only with --pij; reject simultaneous explicit entity and --pij for sessions show. Other dataset show still requires its own entity ID and may use --pij as source scope. Existing session tree positional grammar remains unchanged; --pij may scope it but not invent an entity.
All non-Pij parse/DTO behavior remains unchanged, no new QueryRequest field/core enum. QueryCommand stays unchanged.

App resolves one native mapping, locates/verifies actual source+session and executes once. Generated query actions use the replaced explicit SourceId/session binding, never the live --pij alias; retain continuation instruction original_query_options. No resolver calls in CLI.

Use current CLI escaping for dynamic seat/harness strings; human diagnostics must neutralize control/bidi, machine JSON must escape correctly. Existing unknown/missing/static errors need concrete recovery.

Publish exports and focused parser conflict/shape/provenance/clean-stream tests. Docs explain latest mapping per new query, pinned native source on continuation, retired seats valid, optional Pij availability and no remote/history/cache.
No source/prose-pinning, mock-forwarding or bare not-throw tests. Skip all build/test/lint/format/startup.
Preserve original candidate10e72f9; commit follow-on separately through harness commit; deliver exact SHA/paths/unrun checks.

For pending Pij queries only, validate a clone with turn_range=None until canonical session resolution; retain requested range and revalidate after app inserts the exact session filter. Normal queries stay strict.
